cmhc.product: Rental Market Survey, average rent by bedroom type, Row / Apartment

room.scope: Montréal-wide average asking rent for a room, not per neighbourhood

label_keys.neighbourhood: CMHC area value, rated excellent, very good or good by CMHC
label_keys.zone: wider CMHC zone value, rated excellent, very good or good by CMHC
label_keys.neighbourhood_low: CMHC area value, rated 'use with caution' by CMHC (grade d)
label_keys.zone_low: wider CMHC zone value, rated 'use with caution' by CMHC (grade d)
label_keys.none: not enough data: estimate is null

meta.null_meaning: estimate is null when label is 'none': not enough data.
